data.description: Reusable extraction schema for Australian travel insurance PDS documents (SCTI International Comprehensive – Single Trip, effective 12 Jul 2025; Cover-More Travel Insurance PDS, effective 15 Oct 2025). Supports plan-level records across product families and tiers, capturing insurer/plan identities, eligibility, excess options, key benefits, limits, sub-limits, optional add-ons, COVID-19 features, exclusions, thresholds/waiting periods, and evidence.

product_type_field.description: Classifier for normalised plan type derived from PDS wording and benefits tables. Use Single Trip vs Annual Multi-Trip and Domestic vs International vs Inbound; business and cruise denote specialised products or add-on cruise packs that materially alter cover.
product_type_field.name: product_type

fields.description: Insurer legal name as shown in the PDS (e.g., Southern Cross Benefits Limited trading as Southern Cross Travel Insurance; Zurich Australian Insurance Limited for Cover‑More).
fields.name: insurer_name

fields.description: Brand or trading name used in consumer materials (e.g., Southern Cross Travel Insurance (SCTI), Cover‑More).
fields.name: brand_name

fields.description: Product family name from the PDS (e.g., International Comprehensive, International Plans, Domestic Plans, Inbound Plan).
fields.name: product_name

fields.description: Specific tier or plan option within the product family (e.g., Basic, Comprehensive, Comprehensive+, Single Trip, Annual Multi-Trip). Emit one record per distinct plan tier.
fields.name: plan_name

fields.description: PDS effective date or issue date printed on the PDS.
fields.name: policy_effective_date

fields.description: Edition or document code/version identifier as printed in the PDS.
fields.name: policy_document_version

fields.description: Whether the plan is Annual Multi-Trip (AMT) or Single Trip as marketed.
fields.name: trip_frequency

fields.description: Maximum trip duration allowed per journey for this plan/tier (days). For AMT, this is per trip; for single-trip, this is total journey cap.
fields.name: max_trip_duration_days

fields.description: Maximum covered duration per journey under an Annual Multi-Trip plan (days).
fields.name: annual_multi_trip_max_trip_length_days

fields.description: Geographic scope or areas of travel as required at purchase (e.g., Worldwide, All of Europe, All of Asia, Australia).
fields.name: geographic_scope_selection

fields.description: DFAT/Smartraveller advisory exclusion handling (e.g., No cover for ‘Do not travel’ or ‘Reconsider your need to travel’ advisories, including rules for before/after purchase and while abroad).
fields.name: dfat_advisory_exclusion_policy

fields.description: Residency and Medicare eligibility or visa requirements to buy the plan (e.g., must be an Australian resident and Medicare-eligible; inbound plan for non‑residents).
fields.name: eligibility_residency_requirements

fields.description: Dependent children included and definition (e.g., up to age limit, not in full‑time employment).
fields.name: dependent_children_included_terms

fields.description: Base policy excess options (one per unexpected event), including amounts offered and whether per-event or per-claim logic applies.
fields.name: base_excess_options

fields.description: Named special excesses (e.g., COVID-19 cancellation/additional expenses special excess), with amount and applicable sections.
fields.name: special_excesses

fields.description: Benefits for which no excess applies under the plan (e.g., funeral/return of remains, personal accident, personal liability, rental vehicle excess).
fields.name: excess_waived_benefits

fields.description: Structured capture of benefits, maximum cover, and sub-limits as shown in plan tables. Include benefit names as printed, per-person/policy amounts, unit caps (per day/week/item), age bands, and any waiting thresholds.
fields.name: benefit_limits

fields.description: Threshold that must elapse before baggage delay benefits are payable (hours).
fields.name: baggage_delay_threshold_hours

fields.description: Minimum delay for general travel delay benefit eligibility (hours).
fields.name: travel_delay_threshold_hours

fields.description: Waiting period for hospital daily cash allowance benefits (days).
fields.name: hospital_cash_waiting_days

fields.description: Handling of pre-existing medical conditions: whether any conditions are automatically included and/or medical assessment available; include key rules for undiagnosed symptoms.
fields.name: pre_existing_medical_handling

fields.description: Pregnancy cover detail: up to what gestational week covered and conditions (e.g., cover to 23+6/24 weeks; complications treated as pre-existing).
fields.name: pregnancy_cover_terms

fields.description: COVID-19 cover summary including which benefits apply (medical, cancellation pre-trip/while on trip, additional expenses), any sub-limits, and special excesses.
fields.name: covid_cover_summary

fields.description: If shown, core COVID-19 limits by benefit (e.g., cancellation per policy cap, additional expenses cap) and special excess amounts.
fields.name: covid_cover_limits

fields.description: Baggage sub-limits for unspecified electronics, jewellery/watches, and other items, including per‑item and aggregate caps.
fields.name: baggage_unspecified_item_sublimits

fields.description: Whether customers can specify high‑value items for higher cover and related per‑item caps.
fields.name: specified_items_option

fields.description: Rental vehicle excess cover amount and conditions (e.g., licensed rental company, road type restrictions).
fields.name: rental_vehicle_excess_cover

fields.description: Whether a plan includes a Rental Vehicle Comprehensive Cover feature (e.g., Cover‑More Comprehensive+ collision/loss damage waiver benefits) and its key sub‑benefits/limits.
fields.name: rental_vehicle_comprehensive_cover

fields.description: Personal accident benefits including loss of income (weekly amount and max weeks), total permanent disablement, accidental death, and eligible age bands.
fields.name: personal_accident_benefits

fields.description: Personal liability maximum cover amount and key exclusions (e.g., motor vehicles, drones, animals).
fields.name: personal_liability_cover

fields.description: Cruise cover availability (base inclusion vs optional add‑on) and included cruise‑specific benefits (e.g., onboard medical, ship‑to‑shore medevac, cabin confinement, missed port, missed shore excursions).
fields.name: cruise_cover_details

fields.description: Optional sports/adventure add-ons available and material conditions (e.g., helmets, licensing, engine cc limits, professional/racing exclusions).
fields.name: activity_addons_available

fields.description: Business pack availability and included benefits (e.g., business equipment, hire, alternative staff, kidnap and ransom) and their sub‑limits.
fields.name: business_pack_details

fields.description: Key general exclusions of note impacting comparability (e.g., epidemic/pandemic baseline exclusions unless listed; terrorism; travel against medical advice; government actions; illegal acts; alcohol/drug impairment thresholds).
fields.name: notable_general_exclusions

fields.description: Claims and assistance requirements, including when prior approval/notification is required (e.g., hospitalisation, surgery, or expenses above a threshold).
fields.name: assistance_and_claims_requirements

fields.description: Any free extension of cover rules (e.g., policy extends without charge if unable to return home due to an insured event) and paid extension constraints.
fields.name: policy_extension_rules

fields.description: Source citations for extracted values. Include doc path, page(s), table IDs, and short snippet.
fields.name: source_evidence

notes: Tables are first-class evidence for benefit names and limits (SCTI: Section A-D benefits tables pp.9-12; Cover‑More: International/Domestic/Inbound benefits tables pp.3-9).
SCTI single-trip international product includes optional Moped/Motorbike, Ski/Snowboard, and Cruise add-ons; cancellation limit selectable ($2,500 to Unlimited pp.12, 41).

Cover‑More offers Basic, Comprehensive, and Comprehensive+ tiers across International and Domestic, plus an Inbound plan. Comprehensive+ includes Rental Vehicle Comprehensive Cover (collision/loss damage waiver pack) with sub-benefits (pp.36-37).

Both brands provide COVID‑19 cover with specified sub-limits and a special excess applied in addition to any base excess (Cover‑More pp.5,7,46-48; SCTI states COVID‑19 covered under standard benefits with relevant sub‑limits pp.8-9).
Pregnancy cover up to 24 weeks gestation is referenced by both (SCTI Section C pp.32-34; Cover‑More p.20).
Travel advisory exclusions apply to ‘Do not travel’ / ‘Reconsider your need to travel’ advisories with timing nuances (SCTI pp.24-25, 93; Cover‑More general exclusions).
Baggage delay thresholds typically 12 hours (SCTI D.4.3 p.63; Cover‑More delayed luggage allowance amounts per tier pp.3-7).

Personal accident benefits have age eligibility and waiting periods (e.g., SCTI loss of income begins 30 days after planned return, max 13 weeks, p.71; Cover‑More aggregates liability caps across sections pp.4,7,9).

coverage_categories.description: Emergency medical treatment and related evacuation or repatriation while on a journey.
Emergency dental treatment to relieve pain or restore function.
Daily cash or incidentals payable during eligible inpatient hospital stays, often after a waiting period.
Costs to bring a companion to attend the insured when hospitalised for an extended period.
Funeral/cremation costs or returning remains to home country.
Pre-trip cancellation or amendment costs for insured events, per-person or per-policy.
Additional transport and accommodation expenses due to unexpected events before or during travel, including cutting the journey short.
Allowance for delays to scheduled transport after a threshold duration.
Extra costs to reach a time‑critical event (e.g., wedding, funeral, concert) when delays occur.
Costs to catch up with prepaid connections, cruises, missed ports, or shore excursions.
Return to resume a journey after returning home due to specified serious events.
Loss, theft or damage to baggage and personal effects, including specified/unspecified item sub‑limits and documents.
Essential purchases allowance when checked baggage is delayed beyond a threshold.
Replacement of essential travel documents and cards, including associated costs.
Loss or theft of cash, bank or currency notes, postal or money orders under specified conditions.
Reimbursement of the non‑refundable excess charged by a licensed rental company when a rented vehicle is stolen or damaged.
Comprehensive rental car cover pack (where offered) including collision/loss damage waiver and related sub‑benefits.
Legal liability to pay compensation for third‑party injury or property damage and approved defence costs.
Weekly income benefit for a limited period after return when unable to work due to an insured injury.
Lump sum for total permanent disablement following an injury during the journey.
Lump sum payable to the estate for accidental death resulting from an injury during the journey.
Costs from insolvency of a travel services provider (e.g., rearrangement, cancellation, or return).
Per‑day allowance when forcibly detained due to hijacking of public transport.
Daily pet boarding costs due to delayed return home.
Reimbursement of booked, non‑refundable childcare expenses due to delayed return.
Cruise‑specific benefits provided when a cruise cover option is included or added.
COVID‑19 related medical, cancellation/amendment, and additional expenses cover; often with special excess and sub‑limits.
Optional cover extensions for specified adventure or organised sports activities subject to safety conditions.
Optional cover for snow sports (on‑piste/off‑piste as specified), with exclusions for professional/racing.
Optional cover while riding as rider or passenger subject to licensing, helmet, and engine size limits; liability often excluded.
Optional business travel benefits such as business equipment, hire, alternative staff, money, and kidnap/ransom.
